title: Dr Frost Arctic Apple Black Honeydew 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Apple Black Honeydew Ice combines crisp Apple, sharp, tangy Blackcurrant, and delicately sweet Honeydew Melon flavours, perfectly balanced with an extra-refreshing menthol finish. This complex yet refreshing blend delivers layers of sweet and fruity notes with a frosty exhale, making it an ideal choice for fans of fruity e-liquids laced with bracing menthol. Crafted as part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour to deliver the same bold, intense taste vapers enjoy in disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast nicotine relief. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Apple Black Honeydew Ice offers a versatile and satisfying option for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and icy refreshment.
